falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes above $108,000 on any daily candle
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout to new all-time highs would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, which requires continued consolidation or downside before any recovery. It would signal the blowoff top is still in progress, not complete.

falsification_conditions.condition: Total crypto market cap (excluding BTC) gains more than 15% in 7 days while BTC dominance drops below 48%
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would show risk-on rotation into altcoins at a pace inconsistent with a bottoming phase. The August 2024 bottom analog requires BTC dominance to remain elevated as capital concentrates in the safest asset first.

falsification_conditions.condition: Coinbase spot volume exceeds $8 billion in a single day without a corresponding 5%+ price drop
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: High volume without downside capitulation would indicate absorption by buyers at current levels, not the panic selling that characterizes the bottom_2024_aug pattern. It would suggest the market has already found equilibrium and is accumulating, not bottoming.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
